`WarningIcon` is used in three chart files, all in order-basket error rows. The chart's only other exposure is indirect, through the styleguide date picker.

**Confirmed affected (patient chart app):**

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket/general-order-type/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx` renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` at line 38 inside the `orderError` block of the general-order basket tile. It imports the icon from `@openmrs/esm-framework` at line 5.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-orders/lab-order-basket-panel/lab-order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx` renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` at line 46 inside the lab order error block. Import at line 5.
3. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/drug-order-basket-panel/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx` renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` at line 91 next to the order error text. Import at line 5.

All three sit in the order-basket error display, so a behaviour change (for example, a different glyph, a different size default, or a ref or click change) would show up there.

**Definition in the framework (openmrs-esm-core):**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx` lines 848–852 defines `WarningIcon` as a memoised forwardRef wrapper around `<Icon icon="omrs-icon-warning" />`. Changing this is the behaviour change in question.
- Lines 857–859 define `AllergiesIcon = WarningIcon`. An alias, so it changes with it. I found no `AllergiesIcon` uses in the chart repo.

**Likely but unverified (indirect):**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/datepicker/date-picker-icon.component.tsx` lines 11–19 renders `<WarningIcon ref={ref} size={16} />` inside `DatePickerIcon`. That icon is used by `openmrs-date-picker.component.tsx` (line 153) and `openmrs-date-range-picker.component.tsx` (line 191). The chart almost certainly reaches these through `DatePicker` from `@openmrs/esm-framework`, but I did not search the chart for `DatePicker` usage, so the impact there is inferred.

**Not checked / out of scope:**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx` (line 152) also uses `WarningIcon`, but it is in the login app, not the chart.
- The mock files `esm-styleguide/mock.tsx` and `mock-jest.tsx` define a stub `WarningIcon`. They only matter for tests that mock the framework; I did not check whether chart tests rely on the stub output.
- I searched only string references to `WarningIcon` and `AllergiesIcon`. Dynamic lookups or re-exports under other names would not appear.
